name: Band external rotation
description: Slow external rotations with the elbow pinned to the side.

name: Wall slide
description: Slide the forearms up a wall while keeping the lower back still.

name: Prone Y raise
description: Lying face down, lift the arms into a Y with the thumbs up.

name: Dumbbell overhead press
description: Press from shoulder height to lockout, controlling the descent.

name: Lateral raise
description: Raise the arms to shoulder height with a soft bend at the elbow.

name: Cable lateral raise
description: Steady raises on one side at a time to keep tension through the range.

name: Rear delt fly
description: Hinge forward and raise the arms wide, squeezing the back of the shoulders.

name: Arnold press
description: Rotate the palms through the press to load the shoulder through a full range.
caution: Shoulder impingement risk. Stop if you feel pinching or pain at the top.

name: Barbell overhead press
description: Standing strict press with a full lockout overhead.
caution: Brace the core and keep the bar path close. Use a rack and spotter for heavy sets.

name: Handstand push-up negative
description: Lower slowly from a handstand against a wall.
caution: Heavy load on the shoulders and neck. Stop if you feel neck pain or dizziness.
